voiceScript: Before you use location privacy, stop for this ten-second check. Location Privacy means the real-world choices, risks, and protections involved in location privacy. Picture this: a phone owner encounters location privacy during a normal day and must decide whether to trust a request, setting, or device. Here is why that matters: a rushed location privacy choice can expose information, interrupt access, or give the wrong person an opening. Check the source and the specific location privacy setting before continuing. Use the available location privacy protection and ask a trusted person or IT support when its details do not make sense.
